english.title: Authorised representative fail to be member of scheme during compliance period and to be appointed by written mandate

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an authorised representative appointed under regulation 14(2)(a) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013, failed to be a member of a scheme, on behalf of the producer that you represented in respect of a compliance period, or a part of a compliance period during which that producer put EEE on to the market and the compliance period following the last compliance period during which

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

placed EEE on the market in the United Kingdom and to be appointed by way of written mandate
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(3), 90(1) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
